protocol.claim_boundary: fixed-weight descriptive confirmation of an order-dependent continuous transport score; no channel, routing, adaptation, learning, geometric-mechanism, or causal claim
protocol.confirmation_rule: At delay8, swap_56 minus identity must be positive in at least three of four fresh parameter seeds. If it confirms, report the decomposition into true R2 and both comparator R2 changes; do not treat confirmation as evidence of a channel mechanism. If it does not, report nonconfirmation and do not analyze or intervene on channels.
protocol.fitting_rule: For every condition, fit the projection, cue6 decoder, normalization, and temporal tracker solely on base-order train32. Apply unchanged objects to paired heldout eval32. No heldout-order state, label, transform, or threshold may fit an object.
protocol.matched_target_rule: Each condition applies its exact listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities. Base and heldout paired histories retain the same complete symbol-reliability evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target, subject to recorded floating-point tolerance 1e-12.
protocol.primary_outcome: continuous_transport_margin = heldout orthogonal true-label R2 - max(heldout analytic latest-cue R2, heldout conditional-shuffle R2); report true-minus-latest, true-minus-shuffle, true R2, and both comparator R2 values separately.
protocol.seed_level_aggregation: For every condition and parameter seed, use the median continuous transport margin across the three projection seeds. Projection cells remain dependent descriptive sensitivity measurements.
protocol.selection_rule_result: swap_56 minus identity at delay8: largest absolute eligible mean seed-level continuous-margin contrast (+0.3711); same positive direction in four of four discovery seeds
protocol.target_rule: Each condition applies its exact listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities. Base and heldout paired histories retain the same complete symbol-reliability evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target, subject to recorded floating-point tolerance 1e-12.
